Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V3.2 Thinking
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: DeepSeek‑V3.2 from DeepSeek harmonizes high computational efficiency with superior reasoning and agent performance. It builds on three main techniques: DeepSeek Sparse Attention for long‑context efficiency, a scalable reinforcement learning framework, and a large‑scale agentic task synthesis pipeline. This model excels at long-context reasoning and agentic tasks, efficiently handling extended inputs while maintaining strong accuracy. Its sparse attention design enables it to process complex, multi-step workflows without excessive compute costs. Overall, DeepSeek‑V3.2 targets long‑context reasoning, tool‑using agents, and efficient deployment in production environments.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT 5.1 Thinking
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: An upgraded version of GPT-5 that adapts thinking time more precisely to the question to spend more time on complex questions and respond more quickly to simpler tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT 5.1 Thinking (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: An upgraded version of GPT-5 that adapts thinking time more precisely to the question to spend more time on complex questions and respond more quickly to simpler tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: NVIDIA: Nvidia Nemotron Nano 12B V2 VL
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: The model is an auto-regressive vision language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture. The model enables multi-image reasoning and video understanding, along with strong document intelligence, visual Q&A and summarization capabilities.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Interfaze Beta
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with LLMs for developer tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like OCR, scraping, classification, STT and more.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-5-Codex
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT-5-Codex is a version of GPT-5 optimized for agentic coding tasks in Codex or similar environments.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: NVIDIA: Nvidia Nemotron Nano 9B V2
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 is a large language model (LLM) trained from scratch by NVIDIA, and designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks. It responds to user queries and tasks by first generating a reasoning trace and then concluding with a final response. The model's reasoning capabilities can be controlled via a system prompt. If the user prefers the model to provide its final answer without intermediate reasoning traces, it can be configured to do so.\

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-5 (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT-5 is OpenAI's flagship language model that excels at complex reasoning, broad real-world knowledge, code-intensive, and multi-step agentic tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-5 mini (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT-5 mini is a cost optimized model that excels at reasoning/chat tasks. It offers an optimal balance between speed, cost, and capability.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-4.1 mini (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT 4.1 mini provides a balance between intelligence, speed, and cost that makes it an attractive model for many use cases.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Qwen: Qwen3-14B
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Built upon extensive training, Qwen3 delivers groundbreaking advancements in reasoning, instruction-following, agent capabilities, and multilingual support

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: o3 (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: OpenAI's o3 is their most powerful reasoning model, setting new state-of-the-art benchmarks in coding, math, science, and visual perception. It excels at complex queries requiring multi-faceted analysis, with particular strength in analyzing images, charts, and graphics.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: o4-mini
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: OpenAI's o4-mini delivers fast, cost-efficient reasoning with exceptional performance for its size, particularly excelling in math (best-performing on AIME benchmarks), coding, and visual tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-4.1 (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT 4.1 is OpenAI's flagship model for complex tasks. It is well suited for problem solving across domains.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: o3-mini
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: o3-mini is OpenAI's most recent small reasoning model, providing high intelligence at the same cost and latency targets of o1-mini.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek-R1
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: DeepSeek-R1 provides customers a state-of-the-art reasoning model, optimized for general reasoning tasks, math, science, and code generation.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: o1
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: o1 is OpenAI's flagship reasoning model, designed for complex problems that require deep thinking. It provides strong reasoning capabilities with improved accuracy for complex multi-step tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Amazon: Nova Lite
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: A very low cost multimodal model that is lightning fast for processing image, video, and text inputs.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Amazon: Nova Micro
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: A text-only model that delivers the lowest latency responses at very low cost.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Amazon: Nova Pro
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: A highly capable multimodal model with the best combination of accuracy, speed, and cost for a wide range of tasks.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Mistral: Ministral 3B
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: A compact, efficient model for on-device tasks like smart assistants and local analytics, offering low-latency performance.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Mistral: Ministral 8B
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: A more powerful model with faster, memory-efficient inference, ideal for complex workflows and demanding edge applications.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Mistral: Mistral Small
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Mistral Small currently runs Mistral Small 4, a multimodal model combining instruction following, reasoning, and coding with a 262,144-token context window.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o mini (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT-4o mini from OpenAI is their most advanced and cost-efficient small model. It is multi-modal (accepting text or image inputs and outputting text) and has higher intelligence than gpt-3.5-turbo but is just as fast.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Mistral: Mistral Codestral
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Mistral's cutting-edge language model for coding released end of July 2025, Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code correction and test generation.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o (Fast)
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: GPT-4o from OpenAI has broad general knowledge and domain expertise allowing it to follow complex instructions in natural language and solve difficult problems accurately. It matches GPT-4 Turbo performance with a faster and cheaper API.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Auto Frontier
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Highest performance and capability for any task.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Auto Balanced
Kilo Code 🇺🇸.description: Great balance of price and capability.

Kilo Code 🇺🇸.name: Auto Small
